verdict.rationale: Cline's homepage says you can chat with the agent from Slack and Linear, and run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions or GitLab pipelines. The CLI docs back the headless automation side. However, this rests on a single marketing line with no dedicated setup docs for the Slack or Linear integrations. GitHub and GitLab use appears to mean running the CLI inside a CI pipeline, not native triggers such as issue or PR mentions. missing for 10: dedicated docs for the Slack/Linear integrations, native GitHub/GitLab triggers (issue/PR mentions) rather than CI pipeline invocation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Chat with the agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear. Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
